description: Ordered risk tiers and the keyword triggers that raise a request's minimum tier. Classification is conservative: a specialist may raise it, a workflow carries a min_risk floor, and the effective tier is the maximum of every applicable minimum.
rules: A model cannot lower an explicit policy minimum. The effective tier is risk_at_least(workflow.min_risk, trigger minimums, specialist assessment).
Delegation defines both what may be decided and what may be executed; decision acceptance is not itself action permission.
An external_action request is routed as R3 with human_action_request=true and no executable stage.
Protected requirements, authority rules, sensitive data flows and release criteria are R2 at minimum.

tiers.name: analysis
tiers.example: Read authorized docs; compare options; propose a requirement.
tiers.default_authority: Agent may produce a recommendation. No external effects.

tiers.name: bounded_local_change
tiers.example: Edit a toy app or authorized local branch; run permitted tests.
tiers.default_authority: Requires recorded scope; reversible changes can follow explicit delegation.

tiers.name: consequential_proposal
tiers.example: Change permissions, sensitive data flows, release criteria or major architecture.
tiers.default_authority: Independent review and human acceptance before changing protected behavior.

tiers.name: external_or_high_impact_action
tiers.example: Deploy, publish, send, pay, delete production data or broaden access.
tiers.default_authority: Outside autonomous v0.1 execution; prepare a human action request.

keyword_triggers.reason: destructive; production data may be lost
